title: Private Walking Tour of Seville
text: Awesome experience, guide provided much information, tour was entirely customized to my requirements,  highly recommend!
author: Janet_W

title: Highly recommend
text: Wonderful experience. Highly recommend . We took walking tour around Seville and learned lots of information that we would never know from looking by ourselves
author: GusS62

title: Excellent. Interesting and enjoyable.
text: The private tour of the center of Seville exceeded all our expectations. Our guide, Pedro Casanova, an authentic expert in the city, took us on a journey through Seville’s history and culture with infectious passion and enthusiasm. He was a very pleasant guide who knew how to perfectly combine the information with moments of humor, making the tour a truly enjoyable experience. Highly recommended!
author: davidgQ4435SW

title: Perfect French guided tour with Virginia.
text: We had an amazing tour with Virginia. She speaks perfect French and had us walked around hidden gems in Sevilla. We highly recommend her as a guide!
author: ThomDap

title: Pablo was a great guide...
text: Pablo was a great guide and very knowledgeable about Seville!  He even met us at the train station! At the end we has Tapas. Overall great experience!
author: James_M

title: We recommend the visit
text:
We enjoyed the visit to the Alcazar and the Cathedral of Seville + a short tour of the neighborhood with Beatrix.
Béatriz is very nice and perfectly adapted to the group that was sometimes a little dissipated.
